Title: Azure Service Fabric 6.5 fifth refresh release

Body.Content:
The Azure Service Fabric 6.5 fifth refresh release includes bug fixes and performance enhancements.  Updates to Service Fabric runtime, .NET SDK, and Java SDK are available through Web Platform Installer, NuGet packages, and Maven repositories in 7-10 days within all Azure regions.

Service Fabric runtime

  • Windows – 6.5.676.9590
  • Ubuntu - 6.5.476.1

Service Fabric for Windows Server

  • Service Fabric Standalone Installer Package - 6.5.676.9590

.NET SDK

  • Windows .NET SDK - 3.4.676
  • Microsoft Service Fabric - 6.5.676
  • Reliable Services and Reliable Actors - 3.4.676
  • ASP.NET Core Service Fabric integration - 3.4.676

Java SDK –  1.0.5

To learn more, read the release notes.
